vars.name: GRAFANA_URL
vars.description: In-cluster Grafana base URL the harness renders against. From an agent pod this is the ClusterIP service http://gardenio-grafana:3000 (verified reachable 2026-06-17). AUTH: render as a real user by stamping the auth-proxy header 'X-Auth-Request-Email: <email>@acme.example' on every request — the pod IP is in Grafana's 10.0.0.0/8 whitelist so the header authenticates (auto-signed-up as Viewer); admin basic-auth still works as break-glass. RENDER: the populated path is the PER-PANEL route {{GRAFANA_URL}}/render/d-solo/<uid>/x?panelId=<N>&width=700&height=350&theme=dark&from=now-24h&to=now — render each panel and tile them. The full-page /render/d/<uid> route is BROKEN under our /grafana subpath (returns a 'Page not found' PNG). Do NOT use the public /grafana ingress — it sits behind the AVA forwardAuth code-flow that agent pods cannot complete. Full recipe + why blank screenshots happen: gardenio/docs/grafana-headless-render.md.

vars.name: VM_URL
vars.description: VictoriaMetrics (vmsingle) base URL used as GROUND TRUTH for the accuracy cross-check. In-cluster this is http://gardenio-vmsingle:8428 (resolve via the GARDENIO_VMSINGLE_SERVICE_HOST env var if DNS is unset). Every panel's PromQL is replayed here with /api/v1/query and compared against what the dashboard displays.

vars.name: GRAFANA_ADMIN_SECRET
vars.description: BREAK-GLASS ONLY. The normal auth path is the X-Auth-Request-Email auth-proxy header (see GRAFANA_URL) — the harness does NOT need admin for /api/search, /api/dashboards/uid/<uid>, or /render. Keep this only as a fallback if header auth ever fails. Source: in-chart adminPassword (admin/admin in non-prod); in prod the k8s secret named by grafana.adminPasswordSecret (key admin-password). Never logged.

vars.name: DASHBOARDS
vars.description: Optional comma-separated list of dashboard UIDs to audit this iteration (e.g. gardenio-cost-overview,kbeads-embedding,operated-by). When empty, step-1 enumerates every dash-db via GET /api/search?type=dash-db and audits the full set. Lets an operator pin a single regressing dashboard for a fast loop.

vars.name: ITERATION
vars.description: Iteration tag (fire-time ISO or date stamp) used as the output directory name under docs/grafana-grade/<ITERATION>/. Keeps multiple pours from colliding and lets iterations diff.

vars.name: PARENT_EPIC
vars.description: Tracking epic for this work (the Grafana GRADE mega-epic). Every bug bead filed by the ideate-and-file step is parented here so the operator browses one tree per dimension + one tree of accuracy-drift findings.

steps.title: Grafana GRADE ({{ITERATION}}): warm up Grafana + VictoriaMetrics and enumerate target dashboards
steps.description:
## Step 1: Boot + Warmup + Enumerate Dashboards

Confirm both surfaces are reachable before burning cycles: **Grafana** (renders the panels) and **VictoriaMetrics** (the ground-truth query engine for the accuracy cross-check).

### Prereq: in-cluster access (verified working from an agent pod)

Agent pods reach both services directly by ClusterIP — no port-forward, no Keycloak needed (unlike the beads-viewer audits). Authenticate to Grafana by STAMPING THE AUTH-PROXY HEADER (the pod IP is whitelisted, so the header is trusted and you render as a real Viewer — same path humans use; full mechanism in gardenio/docs/grafana-headless-render.md):

```bash
GRAFANA_URL=${GRAFANA_URL:-http://gardenio-grafana:3000}
VM_URL=${VM_URL:-http://${GARDENIO_VMSINGLE_SERVICE_HOST:-gardenio-vmsingle}:8428}
GH="X-Auth-Request-Email: gardenio-grade@acme.example"   # auth-proxy header → authenticated

curl -fsS "$GRAFANA_URL/api/health" | jq .              # {"database":"ok", ...}
curl -fsS -H "$GH" "$GRAFANA_URL/api/user" | jq .login  # confirms header auth works
curl -fsS "$VM_URL/api/v1/query?query=up" | jq .status   # "success"
```

If either health check fails, do NOT proceed — file a P0 bug parented to {{PARENT_EPIC}} and BLOCK (comment 'BLOCKED' and stop). A dead Grafana or VM is itself the highest-severity finding.

### Enumerate the dashboards to audit

If {{DASHBOARDS}} is empty, list every dashboard:

```bash
curl -fsS -H "$GH" "$GRAFANA_URL/api/search?type=dash-db" \
  | jq -r '.[] | .uid + "\t" + .title'
```

The chart ships three (cost-overview, kbeads-embedding, operated-by); more may appear as the fleet grows. Record the UID + title list in a comment and pass it forward as {{DASHBOARDS}}.

### Deliverables (comments, then close)
- Comment: health table (Grafana DB ok? VM up?).
- Comment: dashboard UID/title list audited this iteration.
- Comment: 'PASS' or per-surface failure detail.

steps.title: Grafana GRADE ({{ITERATION}}): server-side-render every dashboard (d-solo per panel) + pull each panel's model
steps.description:
## Step 2: Capture (screenshots + panel models)

For each dashboard UID, capture both the **visual** (for the Aesthetics/Richness review) and the **structural model** (for the accuracy cross-check in step 3). Store under docs/grafana-grade/{{ITERATION}}/captures/<uid>/.

### Screenshots (server-side render via the image-renderer sidecar)

Grafana's server-side render produces POPULATED PNGs headlessly. The reliable route is PER-PANEL /render/d-solo/<uid>?panelId=<N> — the full-page /render/d/<uid> route is BROKEN under our /grafana subpath (it renders a 'Page not found' PNG). So: render each panel solo, then tile them into a whole-dashboard montage with ffmpeg (already in the agent image). Full recipe incl. the panel-ID sweep + tiling commands: gardenio/docs/grafana-headless-render.md.

```bash
# Panel IDs are usually null in the ConfigMap model; Grafana assigns 1..N at load.
# Sweep the range, keep panels that render real content (placeholders come back at a
# small constant size), at a range that maximises data (try 24h, fall back 6h/1h):
for N in $(seq 1 30); do
  curl -fsS -H "$GH" \
    "$GRAFANA_URL/render/d-solo/$UID/x?panelId=$N&width=700&height=350&theme=dark&from=now-24h&to=now" \
    -o docs/grafana-grade/{{ITERATION}}/captures/$UID/p$N.png
done
# then pad+hstack+vstack into captures/$UID/montage.png (see grafana-headless-render.md)
```

Flag any panel showing a spinner or 'No data' after render. For interactive fidelity (template-var selections, drill-downs) Playwright through the public host needs a real AVA browser session, which headless pods cannot complete — the d-solo render path above is the headless-friendly capture and is sufficient for the GRADE Aesthetics/Richness review.

### Panel models (the cross-check input)

Pull the dashboard JSON so step 3 can replay every query:

```bash
curl -fsS -H "$GH" "$GRAFANA_URL/api/dashboards/uid/$UID" \
  | jq '.dashboard' > docs/grafana-grade/{{ITERATION}}/captures/$UID/model.json
```

Also snapshot what Grafana ACTUALLY rendered per panel (the displayed numbers) via the datasource proxy or the panel query API, so 'displayed' in step 3 is the real on-screen value, not a re-derivation.

### Deliverables
- PNGs per uid/viewport/range under captures/.
- model.json per uid.
- Comment: capture manifest (files written) + any panel that failed to settle (carry to step 3 as a Richness finding).

steps.title: Grafana GRADE ({{ITERATION}}): cross-check every displayed value against VictoriaMetrics ground truth
steps.description:
## Step 3: Accuracy Cross-Check (the heart of this audit)

This is the dimension the operator cares about most: **does the dashboard tell the truth?** For EVERY panel, replay its query directly against VictoriaMetrics and reconcile the displayed value against ground truth. Objective, no judgement yet.

### Procedure

**Step 0 — datasource-gate every target (do this FIRST).** Only Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics targets are PromQL replayable against VM. A target whose datasource `type` is one of {`jaeger`, `victoriametrics-logs-datasource` (LogsQL), `victoriametrics-traces-datasource`, `loki`, `tempo`, `elasticsearch`} is a DIFFERENT query language — classify it **NON-PROM** and EXCLUDE it from the VM replay. Replaying a LogsQL/traces target as PromQL manufactures phantom QUERY-ERROR + MISSING-SERIES rows (ka-0000000446: the `gardenio-eks-api-forensics` VictoriaLogs board did exactly this). Read the datasource off `target.datasource.type` (fall back to the panel datasource). If a LogsQL plane is ever populated (`gardenio-victoria-logs:9428`), validate LogsQL targets against `/select/logsql/query` instead — a separate cross-check, never the PromQL-vs-VM one.

**Step 0b — run the static empty-branch detector (cheap, no cluster).** Before any replay, run `cd gardenio/controller && go test ./internal/grafanagrade/`. It checks one invariant over every chart-shipped board: **a stat panel's empty-result branch must be able to distinguish a real zero from a blind emitter.** The VM replay cannot see this class — it reconciles what a panel showed against what VM held at that instant, whereas this bug only surfaces on the day the exporter dies. Classes: `ungated-zero` (`or vector(0)` with no liveness term — a green 0 painted over a dark counter, ka-0000007164), `stale-window` (`sum(last_over_time(...))` on an instant panel, presenting the last sample anywhere in the window as *now*), `unsupported-novalue` / `novalue-claims-zero` (empty-branch text asserting a cause the empty result cannot establish, in either direction — "counter not emitting" or "no defer events"), and advisory `blind-empty`. Carry every new defect into crosscheck.json as verdict class **BLIND-EMPTY** and file it in step 5. The fix is an instant read with an INDEPENDENT control that is measurably advancing — `sum(gardenio_agents_deferred_total) or (0 * (sum(increase(gardenio_reconcile_total[15m])) > 0))`, or `max(up{job=~"..."})`, or `or (vector(0) and (count(<sibling series>) > 0))`. Do NOT instead compare the panel's window against the emitter's cadence and widen the window: widening a window does not recover a missing reading, it re-dates a stale one — that remedy IS the `stale-window` defect (ka-0000002930, ka-0000004423) — and it over-fires on reset-`GaugeVec` metrics, which are meaningfully absent when the last pass counted nothing. `internal/grafanagrade/testdata/empty_branch_baseline.json` inventories the defects already on main so the guard ratchets; a fix shrinks it.

For each **Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics** panel target in model.json:
1. Extract every `target.expr` (PromQL).
2. Run it against {{VM_URL}}/api/v1/query (instant) or /api/v1/query_range (graphs), using the SAME time window the panel renders.
3. Compare the dashboard's displayed value vs the VM result. Record: dashboard, panel title, panel type, expr, displayed, truth, delta, verdict.
4. Classify each mismatch:
   - **MISSING-SERIES** — expr references a metric/label absent from VM. **Check presence against a WIDE window, not the default snapshot.** `/api/v1/label/__name__/values` with no `start` uses a short label lookback that silently DROPS churny per-pod counters — metrics whose individual emitting pods cycle faster than the lookback, even though the metric family is continuously alive fleet-wide (ka-0000006912: `gardenio_agents_deferred_total` + `gardenio_warm_placeholder_claims_total` were live — last sample <3min old, `count_over_time([24h])` non-empty — yet absent from the default snapshot and mis-flagged as naming bugs). Build the presence set as a UNION of the default snapshot AND `/api/v1/label/__name__/values?start=-30d&end=now`. Only if a name is absent even in the 30d window is it truly dark. Then distinguish a *naming bug* (metric exists under a different name — a real defect to FIX) from a *no-data condition* (the emitter simply isn't producing series here — an honest empty state, not necessarily a bug, but the panel must say so rather than imply zero, e.g. via `or vector(0)`).
   - **AGGREGATION-DRIFT** — the displayed number is technically the query result but the query is misleading: e.g. a `sum(... )` that double-counts, a gauge summed across states that mixes live + prewarmed + idle so a 'count' overstates reality, a rate over the wrong window, missing `by()` so a pie/table mislabels.
   - **UNIT/SCALE** — value correct but the unit/format renders it wrong (the classic decmbytes→mbytes 1e15 bug; percentages shown 0..1 vs 0..100).
   - **STALE/FROZEN** — series exists but last sample is old; panel shows a stale point as if live. Measure the age with `min(lag(<metric>[30d]))` via `scripts/grade_staleness_probe.py`, never with `timestamp(last_over_time(...))` (ka-0000001289) — and see *Detector hygiene* below before reporting a zero.
   - **BLIND-EMPTY** — the panel's empty branch cannot distinguish a real zero from a dead emitter (from the step-0b detector): a constant coalesce with no liveness term, a windowed read shown as current, or `noValue` text asserting a cause it cannot observe.
   - **OK** — displayed == truth within tolerance, query is honest.

### Detector hygiene — every automated detector must be POSITIVE-CONTROLLED (bug ka-0000001289)

A detector's **zero-count is a finding only if the branch can be shown to fire.** The 08-31 and 09-01 reports both printed `0 STALE (auto)` when no staleness detector existed at all, and the first one that did (09-02) measured age with `time() - max(timestamp(last_over_time(<metric>[30d])))` — which in VictoriaMetrics returns the **evaluation-step** timestamp, so it read ~0.03h for a live metric, a sporadic one, AND one silent for 13 days. Identical readings on working and broken inputs: the branch was structurally dead, and two reports carried a clean bill of health no instrument had issued.

Rules for this step:

1. **Measure staleness with `min(lag(<metric>[30d]))`.** NEVER `timestamp(<rollup>(...))` — the whole family reads the eval step, not the sample. `make lint` (and the .rwx/ci.yml test-scripts task) reds any harness under `docs/grafana-grade/*/` that reintroduces it.
2. **Import the canonical probe** rather than re-deriving it: `scripts/grade_staleness_probe.py` (`StalenessProbe.audit()`). It corroborates every reported age against an INDEPENDENT second instrument — `count_over_time(m[W])` presence brackets, which never call `lag()` — and raises `ProbeInertError` when the two disagree instead of returning a comfortable zero.
3. **Publish the reachability ladder** with any zero-count: the count of metrics past descending thresholds (e.g. 6h / 2h / 1h). `audit()` returns it as `ladder`, plus a one-line `positive_control` note the report must quote verbatim.
4. **Word an unexercised zero honestly.** If nothing in the corpus is stale at any ladder threshold, the branch was not exercised by data this iteration — write "no stale metric found", never "detector verified" or "0 STALE (auto)".
5. **Any NEW detector added to the harness** (masking, unit, aggregation, …) must be shown to fire on a known-bad input and stay quiet on a known-good one BEFORE its zero-count is reported. Record that demonstration in the iteration's REPORT.md.

### Known seed findings to re-verify (filed by the research pass, ka-0000008066)
- cost-overview 'Active Agents' = `sum(gardenio_agents_active)` counts EVERY state incl. prewarmed/idle/queued/spawning — overstates working agents. AGGREGATION-DRIFT.
- cost-overview 'Total Cost' uses `gardenio_agent_spend_usd_total` (~$211, correct) while `gardenio_beads_total_cost_usd` reads 0 — confirm the headline picks the right source and nothing else reads the zero one.
- kbeads-embedding panels (coverage_ratio, stale_count, embed_duration, embed_errors, search_duration) reference metrics ABSENT from live VM — decide naming-bug vs no-data and make the panel honest.

### Deliverables
- docs/grafana-grade/{{ITERATION}}/crosscheck.json — full reconciliation table (one row per panel/expr).
- Comment: counts by verdict class (OK / MISSING-SERIES / AGGREGATION-DRIFT / UNIT / STALE) per dashboard, and the worst offenders. This table is the primary input to the Grounded score in step 4.

steps.title: Grafana GRADE ({{ITERATION}}): score Grounded / Richness / Aesthetics / Depth / Ergonomics
steps.description:
## Step 4: Judge — the GRADE rubric (0-10 per dimension)

Combine the objective crosscheck.json (step 3) and metrics with a VISUAL review of the captured PNGs. You MUST actually look at the desktop AND narrow screenshots for every dashboard before scoring — Aesthetics and Richness cannot be scored from JSON alone.

- **G — Grounded (accuracy)** — the heaviest dimension. Drawn straight from crosscheck.json. 9-10: every panel == truth, every query honest. 7-8: all series present, at most cosmetic drift. 4-6: ≥1 AGGREGATION-DRIFT or UNIT bug that misleads an operator. 1-3: missing-series 'No data' or a headline number that is simply wrong.
- **R — Richness (data coverage)** — are panels populated or honestly empty? 9-10: every panel tells a story with live data. 4-6: several silent 'No data'. 1-3: mostly empty.
- **A — Aesthetics (beauty)** — Tufte signal-per-pixel + dark-theme craft: layout, legends, colour semantics, thresholds, no glitches/overlap, readable at both viewports. 9-10: flagship, immediately impressive. 4-6: generic/sparse. 1-3: broken rendering.
- **D — Depth (graph ideas)** — does the dashboard ask the RIGHT questions of the metric surface? Are obvious high-value panels missing (latency histograms, error budgets, saturation, derived rates)? This dimension drives step-5 idea generation. 9-10: comprehensive + insightful. 4-6: only the obvious stats. 1-3: trivial.
- **E — Ergonomics (UX)** — template variables, drill-downs, sensible default time range, panel links (e.g. 'Open in Grafana' from /charts), annotations, responsive layout. 9-10: fully wired + discoverable. 4-6: static, few controls. 1-3: inert.

Overall = mean of the five. Write docs/grafana-grade/{{ITERATION}}/verdicts.json with {score, verdict, observations, issues[], recommendations[]} per dimension per dashboard (mirror the maps-beauty verdicts.json shape). Bar for 'good' is 8 — Grafana is being promoted toward a primary operator surface.

steps.title: Grafana GRADE ({{ITERATION}}): generate new graph ideas + file bug beads per low dimension / accuracy drift
steps.description:
## Step 5: Ideate + File Issues

Two outputs: a fresh catalogue of graph ideas (the operator explicitly wants PLENTY), and one bug bead per low-scoring dimension and per concrete accuracy drift.

### Ideate (append to the idea catalogue)
From the metric surface (`{{VM_URL}}/api/v1/label/__name__/values` + the *_bucket/_sum/_count histograms + the lifecycle/event counters), propose at least 8 NEW high-value panels not yet drawn. Ground each in a real metric that has live series. Examples the surface already supports: LLM request-latency heatmap (gardenio_agent_llm_request_latency_seconds_bucket), tool-call latency p50/p95/p99, agent session-duration distribution, deferred-wait SLO, pod-phase-transition Sankey/state-timeline, mention cold-respawn latency, freeze latency, authz-denial rate, operator-activity leaderboard, account warming/throttle timeline correlated with utilisation, beads-events rate by project (recording rule gardenio:beads_events:rate5m), cost-per-bead efficiency. Record each as {title, panel-type, PromQL, the operator question it answers} in docs/grafana-grade/{{ITERATION}}/idea-catalog.md and carry the best forward as Depth work.

### File issues
For every dimension scoring <= 7 in verdicts.json, file ONE bug bead with that dimension's concrete recommendations, parented to {{PARENT_EPIC}}, labelled area:observability + kind:grafana-grade + the dimension. ALSO file one bead per distinct AGGREGATION-DRIFT / UNIT / MISSING-SERIES (naming-bug) row in crosscheck.json — these are the 'cross-check displayed vs actual and fix' deliverables the operator asked for; they edit the dashboard JSON under gardenio/helm/gardenio/dashboards/*.json. De-dupe against still-open beads from prior iterations (search kind:grafana-grade) — comment a new data point on the existing bead rather than refiling.

### Deliverables
- idea-catalog.md (>=8 grounded ideas).
- Bug beads (one per low dimension + one per accuracy drift), de-duped.
- Comment: bead IDs filed/updated this iteration, grouped by dimension.

steps.title: Grafana GRADE ({{ITERATION}}): publish roll-up report and land the MR
steps.description:
## Step 6: Report + Land MR

Roll the iteration up on the parent epic and land captures + crosscheck + verdicts + idea-catalog on main via an MR so future iterations diff.

### Build docs/grafana-grade/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md
- Header table: iteration, GRAFANA_URL, VM_URL, dashboards audited, gardener, parent epic, date.
- Headline: one-sentence verdict + overall mean, with delta vs the previous iteration.
- GRADE scorecard table: dimension | score | verdict | bug bead filed (per dashboard).
- Accuracy section: the crosscheck verdict-class counts + the worst drift rows, called out explicitly (this is the operator's priority).
- Idea section: the top new panel ideas with their PromQL.
- Per-dimension prose: what holds it back + the rec.

### Land
- git add docs/grafana-grade/{{ITERATION}}/ ; commit `feat(gardenio/observability): Grafana GRADE iteration {{ITERATION}}` ; push branch ; open MR.
- Post the roll-up as a comment on {{PARENT_EPIC}} with the scorecard one-liner + bug bead IDs + MR link.
- If overall mean for every dashboard is >= 8 with G (Grounded) >= 9, file a decision bead asking the operator whether to slow the cadence or declare the surface flagship-ready.

### Deliverables
- REPORT.md merged via MR.
- Roll-up comment on {{PARENT_EPIC}}.
- All step beads closed.
